title: The Cold War
summary: For four decades the United States and Soviet Union faced off across a divided world, never quite going to war — until one side collapsed.

stories.title: The Cuban Missile Crisis
stories.summary: Thirteen days in October 1962 when nuclear war seemed imminent.

events.title: U-2 Discovers the Missiles
events.body: An American U-2 reconnaissance flight photographed Soviet medium-range ballistic missiles under construction in western Cuba. The images reached Kennedy the next morning.

events.title: Naval Quarantine
events.body: Kennedy announced a 'quarantine' of Cuba and ordered the Navy to intercept Soviet ships carrying weapons. The world watched as warships converged in the Caribbean.

events.title: ExComm Deliberations
events.body: Kennedy's Executive Committee debated options from air strikes to invasion. The group leaned toward a blockade and secret diplomacy rather than immediate military action.

events.title: Secret Negotiations
events.body: Through back channels, the US offered to remove Jupiter missiles from Turkey if the Soviets withdrew from Cuba. Khrushchev accepted the deal on the crisis's most dangerous day.

events.title: Withdrawal
events.body: Khrushchev ordered the dismantling of the missile sites. Soviet ships turned back and the weapons were removed under UN inspection. The closest brush with nuclear war in the Cold War had passed.

stories.title: Berlin Blockade
stories.summary: The first major crisis of the Cold War in a divided city.

stories.title: Fall of the Wall
stories.summary: Berliners breach the symbol of division.
